method.terms: Weighted log-odds (informative Dirichlet prior) of Act n-grams against SFS, top 60 reviewed; platform/seeds/cross_domain/ai_act_terms.csv lists every dropped term and its reason.
method.adoption: First month from the milestone month whose 3-month rolling share is above the 95th percentile of the earlier months; at least 12 earlier months.
method.placebo: 200 random months per lag, each able to show the observed lag; p = (1 + placebo lags <= observed) / 201; no multiple-test adjustment.
method.term_lists: primary: the pre-registered terms and matching; amended: the 2026-10-22 amendment. Both are reported, side by side in lags_side_by_side.
method.precision: Up to 50 random matched speeches per re-admitted term and language, read by hand; a term is kept at 0.8 or more. Only the counts are stored.
departures: The EN-SV cosine per article (I-9) is not computed: the stored bge-m3 vectors of the English and the Swedish text are compressed with separate PCA fits, so their cosines are not comparable.
Riksdagen has not yet published the 2026/27 speech archive; the Riksdag lane ends with the 2025/26 archive (last speech 13 August 2026), so its last whole month is July 2026.

Amendment of 2026-10-22 (docs/ai-act-diffusion-preregistration.md): review had dropped ai-system, ai-modell and the sandbox terms as general_language, a reason meant for common phrases with uses outside AI. Re-reviewed against the reason definitions, with every token allowed four letters of inflection and a precision check of up to 50 matched speeches per re-admitted term (kept at 0.8 or more), they form the amended list. It is reported beside the primary list, which stays as pre-registered.

caveat_en: A shorter lag than at random dates is timing, not proof that the Act caused it. A lag whose three-month window holds 5 matches or fewer gives a p-value that says nothing.
caveat_sv: En kortare fördröjning än vid slumpade datum visar tidpunkt, inte att förordningen orsakade den. Vilar en fördröjning på 5 träffar eller färre i sitt tremånadersfönster säger p-värdet ingenting.
